form: An English shingle beach facing open sea, with a low flat ledge of grey rock rising from the shingle where the Mock Turtle sits; below the shingle a strip of firm wet sand where the Quadrille is danced; far along the shore, empty bathing machines and a row of seaside lodging houses dissolving in haze
culture_ref: geography.json#LOC-rock-ledge, LOC-estuary-shore, LOC-seaside-town; world.json#wonderland_real_counterparts cp-lessons; culture.json CUL-015, CUL-025
period: Dream-image of an 1860s English seaside resort remembered from one trip: bathing machines, timber groynes, stucco lodging houses; everything emptied of people

grows_from.waking_detail: Alice's one seaside trip (bathing machines, children digging, lodging houses) mixed with her schoolroom lessons
grows_from.design_growth: Alice's own summary of the English coast (ch002-p16) built as a set but emptied: bathing machines drawn up and shuttered, the children's wooden spades left stuck in the sand, the lodging houses far off and blank. The schoolroom creeps in: the rock ledge is flat and square-edged like a school bench, and the tide-line is chalky white like a wiped slate

dream_design_language: A remembered seaside with the people taken out and the lessons left in: bright, bleached, melancholy; every man-made thing is distant and small, the ledge and the sobbing creature the only thing close. An Art Nouveau-inflected dream shore (SUP-010, XA-magic-08)

mucha_design_language.item: Mucha / Art Nouveau on the shore: the ledge rock's strata run in long flowing curves like Mucha's hair lines, with shells and bladderwrack draped in garland loops; the groyne posts are capped with wrought-iron whiplash wave-scroll finials, verdigris and worn gilt; the bathing machines are painted in faded pastels (sea-green, lilac, cream) with a gilt roundel medallion on each door; the distant lodging houses carry mosaic friezes and round stained-glass fanlights; the wet sand's foam and tide-line lie in whiplash curves; pastel-and-gold sea light
mucha_design_language.why: Dream shore carries the language on its real period elements without adding structures to the layout

structure.item: a little ledge of rock: a low flat-topped shelf of grey stone about 3 m long, 1.5 m deep, its top about 90 cm above the shingle, sitting apart on the upper beach
a steep bank of rounded grey and fawn flint shingle running the length of the shore behind the ledge
structure.note: 'They are waiting on the shingle'; flint inferred as the south-English beach material

structure.item: below the shingle, a broad strip of firm wet sand about 15 m wide to the waterline, flat enough for the Quadrille's two lines and the dancers' advance and retreat
structure.note: 'you first form into a line along the sea-shore'; width inferred

structure.item: a line of dark weathered timber groynes running down the beach into the water at intervals of about 40 m
structure.why: Real Victorian resort beach structure; gives depth and rhythm for the run along the shore

structure.item: background at the far end of the shore: three or four bathing machines at the water's edge, and beyond them a terrace of cream stucco lodging houses with bow windows, small and hazy
structure.note: Alice's seaside summary; placement inferred per grows_from (geography.json#LOC-seaside-town.visual_identifiers)

materials.item: grey weathered rock of the ledge, flat-bedded with square edges, patched with barnacles and a fringe of brown bladderwrack at its foot
materials.why: A readable 'ledge' that doubles as a bench for the seated CGI Mock Turtle

materials.item: rounded flint shingle, grey, fawn and white
firm pale wet sand reflecting the sky
bathing machines: wooden huts on four large spoked wheels, white-painted boards, faded blue-striped canvas hoods, shutters closed

details.item: a tide-line of dried white foam and shell grit along the top of the sand, chalk-white like a slate wiped clean
details.why: The schoolroom seeping into the seaside, per grows_from

details.item: two children's wooden spades stuck upright in the sand near the waterline, nobody with them
details.note: 'some children digging in the sand with wooden spades'; emptied per dream_design_language

details.item: a few stranded lobster pots and a coil of old rope on the shingle
details.why: Real fishing-beach clutter that seeds the lobster talk without any animal on screen

scale_notes.rule: True 1:1 (Alice 135 cm; the Gryphon and the Mock Turtle are photoreal CGI creatures per SUP-010 as amended BIB-0027, sizes set by 04-creatures). The ledge height (90 cm) seats the CGI Mock Turtle with its calf's head just above standing Alice's eye line; the wet-sand strip (15 m) takes the two creatures' Quadrille. The bathing machines and lodging houses are distant background only; if built, use 1:4 miniatures placed 60 m or more back in forced perspective

negative: no underwater scenes, no other sea creatures, no real turtle, lobster or seal (only the CGI Mock Turtle and Gryphon)
no cartoon creatures, no humans in partial creature costume
no flat poster illustration, outline graphics or matte-painting finish
no tropical beach, no palm trees, no turquoise water, no white coral sand
no pier, promenade crowd, Ferris wheel or later seaside amusements
no people on the distant beach or at the lodging-house windows
no lighthouse, no ships with funnels close in shore
no cliffs with caves or fantasy rock arches
prompt_ready_en: a bright melancholy English shingle beach in the 1860s facing open sea, a low flat-topped grey rock ledge with long flowing curved strata, barnacles and bladderwrack draped in garland loops, standing alone on the upper beach, a bank of grey and fawn flint shingle, a broad strip of firm wet sand below with foam lying in whiplash curves, dark timber groynes capped with verdigris wrought-iron wave-scroll finials running into the water, far along the shore empty shuttered pastel bathing machines on wheels with gilt roundel medallions and a terrace of cream stucco bow-windowed lodging houses with mosaic friezes fading into pastel-and-gold haze, two wooden spades stuck in the sand, Art Nouveau accents in the style of Mucha, photographed live-action
